description: Land Acquisition - Welewatta, Kittampahuwa & Wellanpitiya, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for a development project, including lot numbers, land names, uses, claimants, and extents. This fits perfectly within the "Land Gazettes" category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative matters.
